items.paraphrase: Beyond 45 m to the nearest escape door a second escape route with emergency route is required; emergency routes allow 45 m, or 60 m with life-safety sprinklers.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-T; 45 m to nearest escape door before a second route and emergency route are required; 60 m with life-safety sprinklers (4.16.4)

items.paraphrase: Same 45 m rule applies to all occupancies including offices; 60 m with life-safety sprinklers and protected walls.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-T; same 45 m rule for all occupancies

items.paraphrase: Window opening area at least a tenth of room floor area in buildings other than small category-1 F2/H3/H4 buildings (minimum 0.2 m2).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-O; 10 percent of floor area (or 0.2 m2 if greater) for other buildings

items.paraphrase: Five percent of floor area suffices for category-1 buildings of occupancy class F2, H3 or H4 (small dwellings).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-O; 5 percent for category 1 buildings of occupancy F2, H3, H4

items.paraphrase: Clear walking width of an accessible route at least 900 mm; passing spaces 1.5 x 1.5 m at 5 m intervals where narrower than 1.5 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-S; 900 mm clear walking surface; passing spaces 1.5 x 1.5 m every 5 m if narrower than 1.5 m

items.paraphrase: Accessible doorway clear opening at least 750 mm (800 mm recommended); toilet doors 900 mm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-S; 750 mm clear opening, 800 mm recommended

items.paraphrase: Wheelchair turning space of 1.5 m diameter.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-S; 1.5 m diameter turning space

items.paraphrase: Accessible ramp gradient no steeper than 1:12 along its centre line.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-S; 1:12 along the centre line; Table 2 limits rise per run

items.paraphrase: Division area limit without fixed extinguishment: 2500 m2 for residential (other occupancies) and 5000 m2 for offices (class G1).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-T; 2500 m2 without extinguishing installation

items.paraphrase: With fixed extinguishment: residential 5000 m2 on two or more storeys; offices unlimited on one storey, 10000 m2 on two or more.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-T; 5000 m2 for two or more storeys with fixed installation, no limit for one storey

items.paraphrase: Rise of any step at most 200 mm (170 mm where Part S accessibility applies).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-M; rise of any step not above 200 mm

items.paraphrase: Going of a tread at least 250 mm; going plus twice the rise between 570 and 650 mm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-M; going not below 250 mm

items.paraphrase: Escape routes for up to 100 persons need 1000 mm width, rising with occupant numbers; Part M absolute stair minimum is 750 mm, Part S 900 mm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-T; escape stair width 1000 mm for up to 100 persons (1500 mm where Part S applies)

items.paraphrase: General stairway width at least 750 mm between enclosing walls or balustrades.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-M; any stairway at least 750 mm wide

items.paraphrase: Bedrooms need 2.4 m over at least 6 m2; other dwelling habitable rooms 2.4 m over 70 percent of floor and 2.1 m elsewhere.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-C; 2.4 m; bedroom 2.4 m over at least 6 m2, other dwelling rooms 2.4 m over 70 percent of area

items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms not otherwise listed, which covers office rooms, need 2.4 m; passages 2.1 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-C; 2.4 m from the row for other habitable rooms; no separate office row read

items.paraphrase: Office occupancy division area limit without a fixed extinguishing installation.

items.clause: cl. 4.4, Table 3 (G1, two storeys and over)

items.note: read 2026-11-14 via archive.org text copy, SANS 10400-T
